question: Does showing the measured remaining time only in the latter half preserve per-task success and lower whole-task logical cost against both always-measured and never-exposed controls in each of two repetitions?
treatment: M shows actual integer remaining work seconds at each generation. H hides that field. L uses H until twice the integer remaining seconds is at most the original 1800-second limit, then uses M. All three normalize validated source protocol references before any fallback text rendering. Actual deadlines and all other budgets stay common.
comparison_scope: Exploratory ordinary-control comparison on four previously known tasks. P80/P81 and the post-hoc P83 diagnosis informed preparation; they are not fresh paired controls. No claim of a novel method or general quality preservation. Historical native-API success is retained as a quality gap.
common_controls: Same public task/world, model, typed results, ordinary Python exceptions, full returned reasoning, persistent Python, schemas, residual output admission, source reference normalization, first cold request then ordinary prefix caching.
order_rule: Repetition1: task1 M,H,L; task2 H,L,M; task3 L,M,H; task4 L,H,M. Repetition2 reverses each corresponding task order. Same world seed42 and model seed57+call index. No retries or threshold/seed search.
cache_rule: First model request cache_prompt=false and measured cache_n=0/prompt_n=full input are required. Later requests use true. Timing and numerical nondeterminism remain; identical seeds do not guarantee identical trajectories.
budget_rule: Each of 24 cells: 80 model calls,450000 logical tokens,1800 work seconds; output<=4096,context65536; API160 for photo and80 otherwise; setup120,cleanup180,idle60,evaluation180 seconds. All cells reserve<=10800000 tokens and1920 calls; one owned server lease64800 seconds.
failure_rule: Preserve all attempts. Unknown terminal model usage ends the cell with no response execution or retry. If API effects and cleanup are known, wait<=60s for the same idle server, independently evaluate once and continue the fixed next cell. Unknown API effects, cache mismatch, initialization/runtime/cleanup/evaluation failure, changed server or insufficient lease stops the batch. Never impute missing usage as zero.
primary_cost: All newly generated full logical input+output tokens from task start, including reasoning, control notices, failed attempts and recovery. Unknown terminal use prevents an exact task total. Also report cached/noncached input, output, model and API calls, work/setup/cleanup/evaluation/model-load/server residency wall separately. No tokens-to-money or time equivalence.
primary_quality: One official final task-success boolean per frozen cell, with no evaluator feedback returned to the model. No hidden criteria or individual answers inspected.
analysis_rule: Account for all24 new cells. Compare L against M and H separately in each repetition. Report whole-task cost plus paired-success and both-failed contributions, all input/output/cache/API/time measures. Compare all12 same-policy repetition pairs and all24 within-repetition condition pairs,36 dependent pairs total. Keep missing usage/outputs unknown. Do not equate JSON or token identity with whole-task causal effects.
development_gate: All four L-versus-baseline comparisons (two baselines by two repetitions) must have all8 evaluated with known terminal usage and clean audit, no per-task success loss, at least one both-successful task, and strictly lower aggregate whole-task logical tokens. This descriptive gate does not establish restored quality against historical native-API success, generalization, novelty or acceptance.
